data.title: 双叶理央 · 海滨观测站的防水实验
data.description: 【海滨科学观测站·正午】理央穿着深蓝运动泳装与白色防晒外套，蹲在潮池旁记录水温；她把防水平板举向镜头展示一只小螃蟹从石缝探出，眼神在海风里显得比平时活泼。
data.action: 潮池旁记录水温，发现小螃蟹后把防水平板举给镜头看
data.lighting: clear noon light with glassy tide-pool reflections
data.mood: 把研究对象变成假日惊喜
data.promptProse: Rio Futaba from Rascal Does Not Dream of Bunny Girl Senpai wears a navy athletic swimsuit with a white sun jacket, waterproof tablet pouch and clear safety glasses. She crouches beside the observation station with a waterproof tablet, recording the tide pool temperature as a tiny crab appears from the rocks. She angles the screen toward the viewer to share the discovery, her usually reserved eyes brightened by salt air and sunlight. clear noon light with glassy tide-pool reflections.
